answer_1.quote: This work, we investigate decoding methods for generating semantically diverse text which is also faithful to its input focusing on two tasks, namely summarization and question generation.

answer_2.quote: We report the perplexity of the generated sequence ... Lexical Fluency and Relevance We report ROUGE-L F1 scores ... Semantic Relevance We report BERTScore ... Faithfulness ... report on textual entailment ... Diversity We report ... Self-BLEU ... Self-Entailment and Self-BERTScore ... EDNA ...

answer_4.quote: We further assess faithfulness by humans. Our annotators, proficient in English, were tasked to read a document and then grade its summary on a scale of 1-4 ... We further assess diversity by humans. Our annotators, proficient in English, again read two summaries ... and then graded the pair ...
answer_4.guideline: For faithfulness: a summary is 'entirely faithful' if its content is fully supported or can be inferred from the document. For diversity: two summaries are graded on a scale of 1-4 (identical, somewhat identical, somewhat diverse, and diverse).
